scope: A pure, detached, default-off conversion of an already captured H1R-05A owner snapshot to Harbour metadata-reference records. It is not a USI source adapter, registration, activation, migration, or runtime integration.
required_behavior: Accept only exact built-in KnowledgeMigrationSnapshot and KnowledgeHeadMetadata values from H1R-05A.

Validate the exported-snapshot boundary only: exact built-in H1R-05A exported record types, scalar types and budgets, schema id, SHA-256 digest grammar, enumeration/integer bounds, unique ordered heads, record_digest, captured_head_boundary and snapshot_digest. The opaque H1R-05A inner R/T/owner/null-sensitive metadata digests are not re-authenticated because their source values are intentionally not exported.

Return only immutable detached HarbourKnowledgeMetadataReference(schema_id='odysseus.harbour.knowledge_metadata_reference.v1', snapshot_digest, owner_ref_digest, record_digest, knowledge_id_digest, revision, generation, state, knowledge_kind, payload_sha256, classification_digest, retention_digest, provenance_digest, source_revisions_digest, references_digest, revision_metadata_digest, head_metadata_digest) values in the input's verified order; the empty snapshot returns an empty tuple.

Copy every accepted scalar once before conversion and expose no retained input aliases. Reject foreign schemas, subclasses, missing slots, malformed hashes, invalid enums/integers, over-budget values, boundary/digest mismatch, duplicate or disordered heads and bounded hostile objects without sensitive exception context.
forbidden: USI registry, capability or manifest changes
SQLite, filesystem, network, clock or randomness
payload, content, raw owner identifiers, locator, timestamp or alias access
schema change, migration, activation, provider, private-data, deletion or live action
acceptance: Golden conversion, literal output field mapping and deterministic empty snapshot
hostile exact-type, missing-slot, mutation and retained-alias rejection
exported record/boundary/snapshot digest recomputation plus order/duplicate/budget failures
self-consistent synthetic snapshots are explicitly not treated as authenticated origin
no reinterpretation of payload_sha256 as content_hash, source-id minting, Native evidence/locator/binding emission or SourceRecord/SourceVersionRecord/ChunkRecord emission
static proof of no Native store/capture/adapter/registry/I-O calls
focused H1R-05A Store and Native USI regression suites via --noconftest
non_claims: This packet does not satisfy H1R-05 completion and creates no authoritative USI source or migration readiness.
